guidance.value: The company expects 2026 memory-market growth to continue, led by AI infrastructure, data-center demand, and higher-value HBM and DDR5 demand.
Yongin semiconductor cluster: approximately KRW 600 trillion, with the fourth fab construction targeted for completion by 2033 followed by phased production-equipment and tool investment.

management_major_statements.value: Q2 2026 demand strength was led by AI-infrastructure investment and a constrained supply environment; server DRAM and enterprise SSD were cited as key drivers.
The company states that AI inference, Agentic AI, and AI PC adoption are shifting both DRAM and NAND toward higher-performance and higher-capacity products.
management_major_statements.original_location: PDF p.293-294, Management Discussion and Analysis

management_major_statements.value: The company intends to strengthen integration synergies with Solidigm and expand its enterprise-SSD leadership with high-capacity QLC products.

Under the 2025-2027 shareholder-return policy, the company states a fixed annual cash dividend of KRW 1,500 per share and prioritizes financial-health strengthening for the former policy's 5% of annual Free Cash Flow, with possible additional return if financial-health conditions permit.
management_major_statements.source: FY2025 Business Report and H1 2026 Half-Year Report

important_changes.value: FY2025 revenue was KRW 97,146,675 million versus KRW 66,192,960 million in FY2024; filing reports +46.8%.
FY2025 operating income was KRW 47,206,319 million versus KRW 23,467,319 million in FY2024; filing reports +101.2%.
FY2025 net income was KRW 42,947,902 million versus KRW 19,796,902 million in FY2024; filing reports +116.9%.
Q2 2026 revenue was KRW 79,318,746 million; filing reports +50.9% quarter over quarter and +256.8% year over year.
Q2 2026 operating income was KRW 60,542,608 million; filing reports +61.0% quarter over quarter and +557.2% year over year.
Q2 2026 net income was KRW 93,922,593 million; filing reports +132.8% quarter over quarter and +1,242.5% year over year.
H1 2026 financial income was KRW 82,915,164 million, including KRW 63,178,974 million of financial-instrument valuation gains and KRW 13,979,567 million of dividend income.

risk_related_disclosures.value: The company states that memory markets remain exposed to U.S. protectionism, reciprocal tariffs, and heightened Middle East geopolitical risk, although it expects AI-led memory demand growth.

risk_related_disclosures.value: A work-related disease death occurring 2026-06-25 was reported to the Ministry of Employment and Labor on 2026-06-26; the company states it will continue its cohort study.
